name: Question 3
problem:
Find the vector  $x,$ If  $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2}}$ is a basis of $\text{Span}{{b}_{1},{b}_{2}},$ and

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -3 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 4 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 2\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
We know that any vector in  $\text{Span}{{b}_{1},{b}_{2}}$ has the form

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -3 \\ 2\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 4 \\ 3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

where ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ are the coordinates relative to the basis $\,B.$ Since we are told that $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 2\end{aligned}],$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={{(\,-2\,)}_{⏟}}_{{x}_{1}}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -3 \\ 2\end{aligned}]+{{(\,2\,)}_{⏟}}_{{x}_{2}}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 4 \\ 3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 6 \\ -4\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 8 \\ 6\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 14 \\ 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Question 3
?

Find the vector x, If B={b1,b2} is a basis of Span{b1,b2}, and b1=[1−32],b2=[243],[x]B=[−22].

a
[4124]
b
[2142]
c
[2−146]
d
[210−2]
e
[01410]
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

We know that any vector in Span{b1,b2} has the form

x1[1−32]+x2[243] where x1 and x2 are the coordinates relative to the basis B. Since we are told that [x]B=[−22], we obtain

x=(−2)⏟x1[1−32]+(2)⏟x2[243]=[−26−4]+[486]=[2142].
